name: 3d-printer-remote
description: Agent bridge and small-farm control plane for Creality Print 7.2 and Creality OS printers (CR-10 SE first). Your AI agent detects the slicer, edits copies of presets, slices 3MF/STL, checks bed fit, reads live printer data, runs a print queue with filament swaps, tracks history, cost, filament and maintenance, and watches prints with a camera. 2.0 adds an opt-in farm layer: a fleet of printers, a shared queue routed by material, color, nozzle, bed fit and priority with copies, dependencies and failover, autonomy policies with a kill switch, rate limits and an audit log, a local dashboard and REST API with hashed tokens and roles, webhook alerts, and a reconnecting stream. Physical actions run only after the owner says yes in chat and an automatic preflight passes, unless the owner opts a trusted profile into auto-after-preflight. The one exception is an urgent cooldown (heaters off). Hardware-verified on one CR-10 SE for live data, filament moves, start, pause, resume, fan, heat and light; farm features are tested against fake printers.
